    PROJECT HIGHLIGHT

    React Native TypeScript PostgreSQL

    Connect Frame

    A cross-platform mobile application that helps users stay connected with loved ones through shared digital photo frames.

    Key Features:

    • Real-time photo sharing across devices with automatic syncing
    • End-to-end encryption for secure private sharing between family members
    • Intelligent image organization with AI-powered tagging and search
    • Custom display settings for different devices (phones, tablets, smart displays)

    Technical Highlights:

    Built with a modern tech stack including React Native for cross-platform compatibility, TypeScript for type safety, and PostgreSQL for relational data management. The app implements efficient image processing and caching to optimize performance even with large photo libraries.
